content.text: /ext:medcp What is the most frequent diagnosis among women in their 50s in our cohort?
I'll check the clinical data schema first, then query for the most frequent diagnosis among women in their 50s.
This is an OMOP CDM database. "Women in their 50s" = female persons aged 50–59. I'll compute age at each condition, then rank the diagnoses.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT c.concept_name AS diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept g ON g.concept_id = p.gender_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE g.concept_name = 'FEMALE'
  AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 50 AND 59
  AND co.condition_concept_id <> 0
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 15;

content.text: It's SQL Server. I'll use `YEAR()` instead of `EXTRACT`.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 15 c.concept_name AS diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept g ON g.concept_id = p.gender_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE g.concept_name = 'FEMALE'
  AND (YEAR(co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 50 AND 59
  AND co.condition_concept_id <> 0
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY n DESC;

content.text: The full join over all conditions timed out. I'll narrow it: aggregate `condition_concept_id` first (no name join in the heavy query), and pre-join person once.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 10 co.condition_concept_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
WHERE p.gender_concept_id = 8532
  AND co.condition_concept_id <> 0
  AND (YEAR(co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 50 AND 59
GROUP BY co.condition_concept_id
ORDER BY n DESC;
